rationale.keep_ratio: The 40% cells are the shared positive operating point selected by the final corrected external pilot. The 20% cells remain reported overcompression boundaries and are not expanded for noise curves.
rationale.task_alignment: The perturbations directly test the method assumptions used on the same useful-evidence-plus-attack task: low-authority provenance availability, provenance boundary accuracy, and detector coverage.
rationale.pilot_first: Scale robustness cells only after checking execution invariants and whether the curves identify detector/provenance dependence.

acceptance: Every run has 60 unique prediction cells and zero runtime errors.
Dataset and experiment-config SHA-256 values match.
No post-generation answer or attack label is exposed to generation.
Excluded-token retention is zero whenever the non-excluded tier can fill the budget.
Report flat, non-monotonic, and adverse curves without removal.
